text:
harper: quick QA from yesterday's user test on the embeddings+rerank export modal. users asked: which id column are we exporting? the preview shows "id | text | score | vector" but the generated CSV had a different header order. also voiceover reads the entire preview table on open; super noisy.

kevin: saw this in reproduction. also a bug: when you export multiple times the downloaded filename is always `vectors.csv` and overwrites previous files. we should append a timestamp or collection name.

anita: accessibility checklist suggestions:
- set initial focus to dialog heading (tabindex=-1 + focus()) so AT announces title first
- keep large preview aria-hidden until user expands (add explicit toggle with aria-expanded)
- provide a role="status" polite live region that announces: "Preview collapsed: 18 rows, ~220KB" on open
- primary button needs a clear aria-label: `Start export of 18 vectors`

sasha: copy + UX tweaks:
- heading: "Export 18 selected items"
- summary: "CSV: id, text, score. Vector column optional; including it increases size and time."
- preview toggle: "Show export preview (18 rows, ~220KB)"
- filename: `rerank-collectionname-20260323-18rows.csv` by default

matt: dev notes:
- ensure preview DOM order matches final CSV header order exactly. If user reorders columns in UI, export should respect that order.
- add an export-id GUID to the generated file metadata and analytics event: `export_started(export_id, count, filename, columns)`
- fix download name to include timestamp/collection and avoid collisions (use Content-Disposition with a generated filename).

harper: small SR nuance: VoiceOver on mac reads the first focusable element label before the heading if focus lands on a button. so dev should actively focus heading or a hidden h2 with tabindex=-1. NVDA behaves similarly.

anita: also recommend keyboard behaviour: Enter should activate primary action unless focus is inside an editable cell. Escape closes dialog. Provide clear keyboard instructions in small help text.

sasha: product ask: add a checkbox "Include vectors column" (off by default) with small copy: "Vectors increase file size and can slow exports." Also add a retention note: "Download link expires in 7 days."

matt: i'll pick up the filename + header parity + sample CSV snippet in the modal. will also add a small preview CSV snippet (3 rows) that's aria-hidden until expanded but visible to sighted users.

deploy-bot: staging: rerank-export-header-fix pushed to staging at commit c9a7f1  please test voiceover/NVDA and download filename.

harper: summary of action items:
- focus heading on open + add polite live region (dev)
- hide preview from AT until expanded + add aria-expanded toggle (dev + a11y)
- ensure preview header order matches exported CSV; respect user column ordering (dev)
- filename pattern include collection + timestamp (eng)
- CTA aria-label + copy: `Start export` with hidden aria-label count (design)
- checkbox for including vectors + retention copy (product)
- analytics event `export_started` with payload (eng)

kevin: +1, i'll validate download filename handling and the Content-Disposition header.
anita: +1, i'll add test cases for NVDA/VoiceOver to the ticket.
sasha: +1, will drop copy variants in Figma later today.
matt: +1, will open PR for header parity and sample snippet."
